project.name: Inspecto — Entity Lists + the shared entity fact log (optional)
project.description:
OPTIONAL control-plane module (SEP-08 of the Link Analysis separation, 2026-10-01): the Entity List store and its routes (GET /entity-lists, GET /entity-lists/{id}, POST /entity-lists, POST /entity-lists/{id}/members, POST /entity-lists/{id}/retire, POST /entity-lists/{id}/match), the ONE hash-chained entity fact log and its registry fold (EntityFactLog, EntityRegistry — the log Link Analysis also writes its Identity Facts to), the Entity List sidecar and the risk-score WatchListFeed. Package com.gamma.entitylist.
WHY A MODULE OF ITS OWN. Entity Lists were born inside inspecto-geo-link (LA-17) but a watch list or a block list is not a Link Analysis concept — assurance WS-12 needs it without LA. The fact log is shared, so it lives HERE and inspecto-geo-link depends on this module, never the reverse. On-disk format and paths are unchanged ({write root}/audit/entity-facts/, {write root}/audit/entity-facts/mask.key): a Space created before the move keeps verifying its chain.
Contributed through the core's public com.gamma.spi.http.RouteModule ServiceLoader seam and bundled in exactly the editions that ship inspecto-geo-link (Standard, Professional, Enterprise, Preview); on Personal the core answers the six routes with 503 "not installed" (AbsentModuleRoutes) and /bootstrap reports features.entityList=false.
THIN, like inspecto-ops / inspecto-geo-link: nothing beyond what the core already supplies, so no shade and no sidecar classifier. Built only under the "edition-standard"/"-professional"/"-enterprise"/"-preview" profiles (see the parent pom's profile-scoped <modules>), so a routine "mvn -o clean test" (= Personal) never compiles it.
